description:
One Player is a native video and music player written in Kotlin and jetpack compose. It provides a simple and easy-to-use interface for users to play videos/audios on their Android devices
👉This project is still in development and is expected to have bugs
• Email: helpline.prime.zs@gmail.com
• Telegram: https://t.me/audiofy_support
Supported formats:
• Audio: Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, ALAC, PCM/WAVE (μ-law, A-law), MP1, MP2, MP3, AMR (NB, WB), AAC (LC, ELD, HE; xHE on Android 9+), AC-3, E-AC-3, DTS, DTS-HD, TrueHD
• Video: H.263, H.264 AVC (Baseline Profile; Main Profile on Android 6+), H.265 HEVC, MPEG-4 SP, VP8, VP9, AV1
• Streaming: DASH, HLS, RTSP
• Subtitles: SRT, SSA, ASS, TTML, VTT
Key Features:
• Native Android app with simple and easy-to-use interface
• Completely free and open source and without any ads or excessive permissions
• Material 3 (you) support
• Audio/Subtitle track selection
• Vertical swipe to change brightness (left) / volume (right)
• Horizontal swipe to seek through video
• Media picker with tree, folder and file view modes
• Playback speed control
• Controls lock
• No ads, tracking or excessive permissions
• Bookmark – The player auto-bookmarks the media you are playing.
• URL Playing – Enter URL to play any video on the web (streaming).
• Equalizer – Powerful equalizer to enjoy high quality audio.
• Background play – Listen to your favourite video and audios in background
• Refresh – Auto-refreshes (scans) & manage media (audio/video) from local storage.
• Playlists – Create and manage Playlists for your audios and videos.
• Night Mode – Supports auto, Light and dark modes as well.
• Lightweight (<5MB) yet powerful
• Battery‑friendly for long playback sessions
• Background Playback allows you to play videos in background.
• More – Sleep Timer, Playback Speed, Repeat Mode, Shuffle etc.
Project Repo: https://github.com/googol-apps/OnePlayer
